consumed: As the start of the cosmic collapse trilogy, and the first album for the project, Consumed by A Funeral Star explores the existential dread of the empty universe rooted in melodic death metal.
homeless: Homeless and Hopeless is about feeling lost and transient in society. The theme of collapse carries into how far one can actually fall, even in one of the richest cities in the world.
silver-and-sorrow: Silver and Sorrow describes a romantic border town that is ultimately inescapable. Violence, love, and music collide together. Fusing the beauty of Mexican ranchera, bolero, narcocorrido, and black metal.
now-we-ignite: Now We Ignite begins the Ignition trilogy, returning to cosmic themes of growth and metamorphosis. The root of the album is the “supernova”, the violent explosion of light, the birth of new stars and the death of old. Power metal and techno fusion, and themes of life and death that are the supernova, both literal and metaphysical.
monuments: Second in the Ignition trilogy, Monuments is rooted in greed. The growth of power and control, igniting the economy for the select few and burning society as the product. Trap metal and hip-hop fuse to make the sound.
saudade-by-the-sea: Saudade, a deep, bittersweet emotional state of nostalgic longing and melancholy for someone, something, or a place that is absent, distant, or may not even exist. Love is the ultimate ignition, but it may not always end well. Each song explores a different regional romantic sound, from morna, to arabesk, to trot, to chanson.
a-scar-in-the-star: An angry and bitter album about feeling fractured, by home, by life, by people, by religion, until it all ends. Why does it feel so good though? :)
survive-until-dawn: A reflection in a single night that feels impossible to survive. Will we make it?
